steps.prompt: Does $7316$ divide by $4$? Can you tell without dividing the whole number?

cards.title: Look at the end
cards.body: $100$ divides by $4$, so all the hundreds in a number divide by $4$. Only the last two digits decide: $7316$ divides by $4$ because $16$ does. For $8$, $1000$ divides by $8$, so look at the last three digits.

cards.title: Worked example: remainder by 4
cards.problem: What is the remainder when $5338$ is divided by $4$?

steps.text: Only the last two digits matter: $38$.

try.prompt: What is the remainder when $38$ is divided by $4$?

cards.title: Halve twice
cards.body: To test the last two digits for $4$, halve them twice: $16 \to 8 \to 4$, a whole number, so yes. $38 \to 19 \to 9.5$: no.

prompts: Why don’t the hundreds matter when testing for $4$?
